agent: balancing, live reading through Cheat Engine, 2026-11-09
question: why the pick of divisions for another theatre returns fewer than asked

addresses.name: CAIUnit::DistanceToTheatreFronts
addresses.comment: Walks the theatre's fronts (CTheatre +0x50) and each front's province array, keeping the least SQUARE of the distance, 16 * (dx*dx + dy*dy) in signed 32 bits with x wrapped at half the map's width, from a first best of 1000000 (0x4B08D2, compared at 0x4B0971), and takes Newton's integer root only after both loops; a best of 1 or less is returned as it stands. So anything over 1000 from a front (four times the map's pixels: 250 pixels), and any theatre with no fronts, answers exactly 1000. Callers: CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives, and CAIUnit_PickDivisionsToGive at 0x8BFC57 and in its scoring loop, where the cap is what holds the balancing back: every candidate at the cap scores (1 - 1000/1000) = 0 and cannot be picked. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-balancing.md.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4B08C0-0x4B09A5; live, 5 January 1936: maxD exactly 1000.0 in the pick for every British taker with 2 to 16 fronts, and one candidate at 785 scoring 2.15
addresses.revises: the seed is against the square and not the distance, so the answer is capped at 1000; adds the pick as a caller
